Case File: MB-2023-9001 (Homicide of Environmental Consultant Jonas Sterling, Irrigation Canal Access Rd, Imperial County [Brawley], CA — Incident Date: `2022-09-14 06:15 PDT`)
Exhibit A [doc02_pilot_statement_hollister.txt]: Statement of Agricultural Crop-Duster Pilot Vance Hollister, `2022-09-15`: "At `06:15 PDT` on Wednesday morning, September 14th, I was already airborne in my Air Tractor AT-802A (`Tail N802VH`) flying low-level `10-foot AGL` fungicide spray passes over **Section 18 Alfalfa Block (`3 miles south of the Brawley canal road where Jonas Sterling was shot`)**. Between `06:00 and 06:45 PDT`, the sky was already bright post-sunrise daylight, the surface wind was a steady `14-knot westerly crosswind` that pushed my spray plume due east, and there were zero airspace restrictions anywhere in Imperial Valley!"
Exhibit B [doc06_faa_notam_satloc_gps_and_cimis_almanac.csv]:
FAA FDC NOTAM Archive, Satloc Bantam Ag-GPS Boom-Flow Telemetry (`Tail N802VH`), USNO Solar Ephemeris, & California Irrigation Management Information System (CIMIS Station #141 Brawley) (`2022-09-14`):
- `USNO Solar Almanac (Brawley, CA — 32.97°N, 115.53°W on 2022-09-14)`: Civil Twilight Begins = **`06:03 PDT`**; Official Sunrise = **`06:27 PDT`** (`At 06:15 PDT, the sun was still 12 minutes BELOW the eastern horizon, violates 14 CFR § 137.49 daylight-only unlighted obstacle spraying rules`).
- `CIMIS Station #141 Brawley & Cal DPR Title 3 CCR § 6614 Spray-Drift Almanac (`06:00–06:45 PDT`)`: Surface Wind = **`0.8 mph (0.7 knots) Dead Calm with a 4.2°F Surface Temperature Inversion`** (`NOT a 14-knot westerly wind; moreover, under California aerial pesticide regulations, spraying in winds >10 mph / 8.7 knots is strictly prohibited`).
- `FAA FDC NOTAM #2/9418 (Temporary Flight Restriction — Issued 2022-09-13 22:00 UTC)`: Active **`3-NM radius TFR from Surface to 3,000 ft MSL over Section 18 (`05:30 to 09:00 PDT`)`** for a border pipeline inspection drone operation (`zero aircraft entered the TFR on Imperial County ADS-B radar`).
- `Seized Satloc Bantam GPS Spray-Boom Logger (`Card #SAT-802VH-0914` from Air Tractor N802VH)`: Logged **`ENGINE_START / GPS_LOCK` at the Brawley Municipal strip at `07:12:44 PDT` (`57 minutes AFTER the 06:15 PDT shooting`)**, with `0.00 gallons/min` boom-valve flow prior to `07:21 PDT`!
Audit Vance Hollister's `06:15 PDT` crop-dusting alibi against the USNO sunrise ephemeris, CIMIS wind/inversion data, FAA TFR `#2/9418`, and Satloc GPS spray-boom telemetry.

CASE BLUF: Four independent aeronautical, meteorological, and machine records (`doc06`) invalidate Vance Hollister's claim (`doc02`) that he was flying low-level fungicide passes over Section 18 in Air Tractor `N802VH` at `06:15 PDT` on `2022-09-14`: USNO solar data confirms `06:15 PDT` was **12 minutes before official sunrise (`06:27 PDT`)**; CIMIS Station `#141` recorded **`0.7-knot` dead calm under a `4.2°F` temperature inversion** rather than a `"14-knot westerly crosswind"` (which would also violate California's `10-mph` aerial spray ceiling); Section 18 was closed under active **FAA TFR NOTAM `#2/9418` (`05:30–09:00 PDT`)** with zero ADS-B tracks; and `N802VH`'s onboard **Satloc Bantam GPS spray logger (`#SAT-802VH-0914`)** proves the aircraft did not start its engine until **`07:12:44 PDT`** (`57 minutes after the 06:15 PDT homicide`).

1. AERONAUTICAL, ALMANAC & SATLOC GPS CONTRADICTIONS:
   - **Pre-Sunrise Darkness (`06:15 vs. 06:27 PDT Sunrise`, `doc02` vs. `doc06`)**: Hollister claimed `"bright post-sunrise daylight"` at `06:15 PDT`. USNO ephemeris (`doc06`) places official sunrise at **`06:27 PDT`**.
   - **Wind Physics & Regulatory Ceiling (`0.7 kt Calm vs. Claimed 14 kt Westerly`, `doc02` vs. `doc06`)**: Hollister claimed a `14-knot (16.1 mph)` westerly crosswind. CIMIS `#141` (`doc06`) logged **`0.7 knots (0.8 mph)` calm winds** with a `4.2°F` inversion, and a `14-knot` wind would breach Title 3 CCR § 6614's `10-mph` aerial-application cutoff.
   - **Active FAA TFR `#2/9418` & Satloc Engine-Start Timestamp (`07:12:44 PDT`, `doc06`)**: Section 18 was under surface-to-3,000-ft TFR `#2/9418` (`05:30–09:00 PDT`), and `N802VH`'s Satloc Bantam memory card `#SAT-802VH-0914` recorded `ENGINE_START / GPS_LOCK` at **`07:12:44 PDT`** and first spray-boom valve opening at **`07:21 PDT`**.

2. RECORD LIMITATION & INNOCENT ALTERNATIVE:
   - **What the Records Prove**: Air Tractor `N802VH` was stationary on the ground until `07:12:44 PDT`, leaving Hollister with zero verified alibi at `06:15 PDT`.
   - **INNOCENT ALTERNATIVE**: An agricultural pilot might fabricate an early `06:15 PDT` flight time to conceal an unrelated pre-flight logbook discrepancy or because he confused Wednesday morning's `07:12 PDT` TFR-delayed departure with an earlier dawn run on Tuesday (`2022-09-13`).

3. NEXT LEAD:
   - SubpoenaBrawley Municipal Airport hangar gate keypad logs and ALPR cameras (`05:30–07:15 PDT`) for Hollister's pickup truck, and pull cell-site location information (`CSLI`) for Hollister's phone across the `06:15 PDT` canal road homicide window.

That proves I was across the border in Canada!"

AT&T / Rogers Roaming Log (`22:48:12 EDT`) | `MSISDN 313-555-0198` handed off from `AT&T Detroit Site MI-1104` (`22:44:02 EDT`) to `Rogers Wireless Site CAN-ROG-419 (Windsor Riverfront Rooftop, 42.3175°N, 83.0580°W)`, `Sector 3 (Azimuth 255° WSW — pointing directly across the 850-meter-wide Detroit River toward Detroit Riverside Park)` at **`LTE Timing Advance TA = 19` (`1,482m ± 78m`)**.

Explain what the Rogers Wireless Canadian roaming ping and `TA = 19` (`doc06`) prove and cannot prove regarding Viktor Kovacs's Windsor alibi (`doc02`).

1. CROSS-BORDER ROAMING & TIMING-ADVANCE TRANSLATION:
   - **Why Canadian Roaming Occurs on the Detroit Shoreline:** Radio waves do not stop at international water boundaries. Along the 850-meter-wide Detroit River, unobstructed over-water propagation routinely causes U.S. handsets on the Detroit riverfront to hand off to high-elevation Windsor, Ontario towers (`CAN-ROG-419`), triggering automated international roaming billing rows (`doc06`).
   - **Why `TA = 19 (1,482m ± 78m)` on `Sector 3 (255° WSW)` Excludes Windsor and Intersects Detroit Riverside Park:** `CAN-ROG-419` sits on the Windsor waterfront (`42.3175°N, 83.0580°W`) with `Sector 3` aimed `255° WSW` across the water toward Detroit. Any location along the `255° WSW` boresight inside Windsor is `< 150 meters` from the tower (`TA = 0 or 1`), whereas `TA = 19` (`1,482m ± 78m`) lies completely across the 850-meter river channel on the Detroit shoreline (`1,460m WSW` at Riverside Park, corroborated by Kovacs's `22:44:02 EDT` connection to `AT&T Detroit Site MI-1104` and zero CBP/CBSA border crossings in `doc06`).
2. INNOCENT ALTERNATIVE / RECORD LIMITATIONS:
   - While `TA = 19` on `CAN-ROG-419 Sector 3` proves the handset was on the Detroit side of the river (`~1.48 km WSW` of the Windsor tower) rather than in a Windsor café, the `120°` sector arc (`195°–315°`) at `1,482m` also encompasses adjacent West Fort Street and Jefferson Avenue corridors in Southwest Detroit outside Riverside Park.

Case File: MB-2021-4301 (Homicide of Ski Resort Developer Arthur Vance, Frisco Marina Boat Ramp [I-70 Exit 203], Summit County, CO, 2021-02-09)

- `Gantry_4 [CDOT-I70-EB-MP259.0 — Golden (`27.0 miles` from MP 232.0)]`: `22:59:15 MST` (`Elapsed = 26 min 15 sec` -> Average Speed = **`61.71 mph`**).
Task: Audit Brent Keller's nonstop `60 mph` I-70 eastbound drive claim (`doc02`) against the CDOT multi-gantry ALPR/ExpressToll speed-distance chain (`doc06`).

   - **Segment 2 (`MP 213.6 to MP 232.0`, `18.4 miles`):** `22:15:12 to 22:33:00 MST` (`17 min 48 sec = 0.2967 hr`) -> **`62.02 mph`**.
   - **Segment 3 (`MP 232.0 to MP 259.0`, `27.0 miles`):** `22:33:00 to 22:59:15 MST` (`26 min 15 sec = 0.4375 hr`) -> **`61.71 mph`**.
